name: biblioteca-api-tests
description: Pruebas automatizadas de la API de biblioteca con Postman + Newman

scripts.test:api: newman run postman/Biblioteca.postman_collection.json -e postman/local.postman_environment.json -r cli,htmlextra --reporter-htmlextra-export reports/biblioteca.html --reporter-htmlextra-title "Biblioteca API - Pruebas funcionales"
scripts.test:data: newman run postman/Biblioteca-DataDriven.postman_collection.json -e postman/local.postman_environment.json -d postman/data/libros-validaciones.csv -r cli,htmlextra --reporter-htmlextra-export reports/data-driven.html --reporter-htmlextra-title "Biblioteca API - Validaciones data-driven"
scripts.test: npm run test:api && npm run test:data
